source_title: Naomi Scott & Kit Harington in Sci-Fi Romance 'Eternal Return' Trailer
source_excerpt:
"Taking you back to your past is meant to be an adventure." Quiver Distribution has revealed the sweeping romantic first official trailer for Eternal Return , a fantasy sci-fi romance film made by filmmaker Yaniv Raz as his third feature so far. This recently premiered at the 2026 Toronto Film Festival though reviews are quite mixed so far. Intro via TIFF: "Visually innovative and intoxicatingly romantic, this fantasy drama from writer-director Yaniv Raz ( Dr. Bird's Advice For Sad Poets ) stars Naomi Scott , Kit Harington , and Simon Callow as an adventurous trio journeying back through time in search of the power to love again." The story follows Cass, a young woman who has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer, on her 29th birthday. Along with his friend Malcolm, the pair will attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again. The cast also includes Sonoya Mizuno , Jay Lycurgo , and Simon Kunz . This seems like an incredibly ambitious star-crossed lovers concept we don't often see anymore. Featuring some nice visuals following this story back in time, then all the way back to the present.
Here's the first official trailer for Yaniv Raz's film Eternal Return , direct from Quiver's YouTube :
The film follows Cass (Naomi Scott), a young woman who has resigned herself to a life without love—until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), an enigmatic mapmaker who charts journeys to imaginary places, and his partner-in-crime, Malcolm (Simon Callow), whose relentless quest to travel back in time awakens Cass to love again. Eternal Return is written and directed by filmmaker Yaniv Raz , director of the films Son of Morning and Dr. Bird's Advice for Sad Poets previously, and many other short films previously. Produced by Jillian Apfelbaum, Emma James, Greta Fuentes, Naomi George, Margot Hand, Lindsay Hicks, Yaniv Raz, Moby James Lopez, Naomi Scott, Jordan Spence, Tristen Tuckfield. This initially premiered at the 2026 Toronto Film Festival this fall as a Special Presentation . Quiver Distr. releases Yaniv Raz's Eternal Return film in select US theaters starting December 5th, 2026 coming soon. Look any good? Anyone interested?
